requirement.functional.name: OrderExpiry
requirement.functional.@statement: An unpaid order is never expired by a wall-clock timer
requirement.functional.@counterexample: An order cancelled by elapsed time rather than by the customer
requirement.functional.@notes: The timer shipped in 2026-03 and was removed in 2026-06: it cancelled orders mid-checkout whenever a payment provider was slow. Do not reintroduce clock-driven cancellation.

requirement.functional.name: OrderHold
requirement.functional.@statement: An unpaid order is held until the customer abandons it or pays
requirement.functional.@counterexample: An order that disappears while its payment is still in flight

requirement.architectural.name: NoAmbientClockInDomainLogic
requirement.architectural.@statement: Domain rules never read the wall clock directly
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: A branch whose outcome changes with the time of day it runs

requirement.architectural.name: ClockIsInjected
requirement.architectural.@statement: Domain rules receive the current time as an argument
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: A rule that calls a system clock inside its own body
